info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Human Resources Direction API
info.description: The Human Resources Direction API provides essential endpoints for managing and retrieving human resources information within an organization. This API allows users to access HR directives, policies, and operational guidelines that govern human resources practices. Typical consumers include HR personnel, system integrators, and organizational managers looking to access HR-related data efficiently. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their HR management processes and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulations.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the current direction and strategies implemented within the human resources department, providing insights into policies, initiatives, and overall HR governance.
